title: Phase 1: secure the core MCP internal API boundary. Full spec: docs/MCP-PRODUCTION-FIX-PLAN.md
acceptance: API-key middleware applied to the complete /internal/mcp/* router and any MCP-only reminder/token-exchange route
startup fails when MCP_INTERNAL_API_KEY is absent or empty in production
credentials compared in constant time; 401 for missing/invalid keys without logging secret values
NetworkPolicy permits MCP-to-core traffic and denies unrelated pods; TLS retained on the public service path
route-level tests cover every protected route with missing, invalid, and valid keys
no MCP internal operation is reachable without the configured key
